marks.gloss_en: אלא מעתה את כדר לעמר דפסק להו ספרא בתרי, הכי נמי דתרי שמי נינהו?
אמרי: התם בשתי תיבות פסיק להו, בשני שיטין לא פסיק להו; אבל הכא אפילו בשני שיטין נמי פסיק להו
and among grasshoppers, any that has ... [four legs, four wings, jumping legs, and whose wings cover most of it -- is kosher] (the lemma cites only the opening; the rest is the mishna at 59a)
one that does not have [them] now and will grow [them] after a time, such as the zachal -- is permitted
arbeh -- this is the govai (both schools: 65a.9, 65a.10)
these are generalizations of generalizations, and these are details of details
ציפרתא נמי מקלט קלטה -- the tziparta too catches from the air, [and it is kosher]; so catching from the air cannot be the sign
קולט ואוכל קאמרי -- the sign is a bird that catches and eats [in the air] (= p_abaye_koleit_veochel)
the tziparta too catches [from the air]
כמאן? כרבי אליעזר, דתניא: לא לחנם הלך זרזיר אצל עורב אלא מפני שהוא מינו -- the 'dwells with' sign would be R' Eliezer's alone
אפילו תימא רבנן, שכן ונדמה קאמרינן -- even the Rabbis agree: the sign is dwelling with them AND resembling them (= p_shachen_venidme_tamei)
R' Eliezer: not for nothing did the starling go to [dwell with] the raven, but because it is its kind
but the Sages said: any bird [that claws is non-kosher] (the lemma cites only 'any bird'; the rest is the mishna at 59a)
Others: [a bird that] dwells with non-kosher [birds] -- non-kosher
